repita: I was watching TV at nine.
Eu estava assistindo à TV às nove.
I was watching TV at nine

texto.titulo: At nine o'clock / Às nove horas
texto.ru: At nine o'clock last night, everyone in my house was doing something different. My father was watching the news. My mother was talking to my aunt on the phone. My sister was studying for a test and my brother was playing the guitar. I was cooking dinner, and the dog was waiting next to me. It was raining, and nobody was sleeping. It was a normal evening.
texto.pt: Às nove horas da noite passada, todos na minha casa estavam fazendo algo diferente. Meu pai estava vendo o noticiário. Minha mãe estava falando com a minha tia ao telefone. Minha irmã estava estudando para uma prova e meu irmão estava tocando violão. Eu estava preparando o jantar e o cachorro estava esperando ao meu lado. Estava chovendo e ninguém estava dormindo. Foi uma noite normal.
